actual: The HMM PR-slice selector requires a mapped direct-neighbor test to exist even when the changed HMM source and that test are intentionally deleted together. This blocks safe atomic retirement of terminal HMM contracts. Preserve fail-closed behavior for added or modified source, but allow deleted source whose mapped test is also absent while retaining the stable smoke slice.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
